question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: thirteen requests, one per tool the endpoint lists, each a tools/call (jsonrpc 2.0) whose arguments carry only meta['ucp-agent'].profile, the vendor's own published example agent profile, and nothing else; preceded by GET hardware.shopify.com/.well-known/ucp and a keyless tools/list on the endpoint it names and on the storefront host. No Authorization header, no HTTP signature, no cookie jar, no payment, no initialize; user-agent public-agents-ci. Sections (D), (L), (G2) to (G14) of the artifact, 18:07:30Z to 18:07:40Z; the command below re-run verbatim as section (R) at 18:11Z

decoded.gated: complete_checkout (18:07:33Z) and get_order (18:07:36Z): HTTP 403, JSON-RPC error -32000 AuthenticationRequired, data 'Unauthorized: A valid JWT is required to call <tool>. See https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/get-started/authentication for instructions on generating a token and authenticating your requests.' Neither names an argument: the refusal comes before arguments are read
decoded.not-gated: the other eleven: HTTP 200 with isError true and a text content 'Missing required arguments: <names>', naming id (cancel_cart, cancel_checkout, get_cart, get_checkout), cart (create_cart), checkout (create_checkout), catalog (get_product, lookup_catalog, search_catalog), cart, id (update_cart) and checkout, id (update_checkout). No credential is asked of any of them, create_checkout included
decoded.ordering: the two refusals name the tool and no argument and the eleven name arguments and no credential, so this server checks the credential first, per tool, and create_checkout is not a tool it gates. Same two and same eleven as 2026-09-20 (p-20260920-shopify-ucp-tool-auth-gate) and 2026-09-29 (p-20260929-shopify-ucp-profile-gate, Part B), twenty-five days on, and on the day the vendor's Cart MCP page no longer carries 'Checkout MCP isn't available without authentication' while its Checkout MCP page still requires authentication of every request (the entry, version 7, carries both readings). The documentation moved; the gate did not
decoded.listing: GET https://hardware.shopify.com/.well-known/ucp answers 200, 4,868 bytes, and names https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp as the dev.ucp.shopping MCP endpoint (transport mcp, version 2026-08-25). A keyless tools/list answers 200 with the same thirteen tool names on that endpoint and on https://hardware.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp, the storefront host: cancel_cart, cancel_checkout, complete_checkout, create_cart, create_checkout, get_cart, get_checkout, get_order, get_product, lookup_catalog, search_catalog, update_cart, update_checkout. Both lists are in the artifact by name only; the full tool schemas (about 179 KB each) are not archived
decoded.transient-errors: none in this pass: all sixteen requests answered on their first attempt. The same thirteen calls at 06:07Z the same morning, described in pull request #275 and kept in no transcript, saw four of twenty-five answer HTTP 503 with a storefront SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE body, each a plain argument error on retry seconds later. The script behind this record re-asks any 502, 503 or 429 up to three times for that reason and did not need to; a gate map that does not re-ask its refusals would have filed those 503s as refusals
decoded.why-filed: the entry's version 7 and its agentAccess.notes cite a 2026-10-15 re-measurement, and the morning run had no archived transcript, so a dated cell pointed at no record. This is the record, with its transcript, and the reproducibility command below is the command that was run: its answers are section (R) of the artifact
decoded.not-measured: no cart, checkout, order or purchase: every call carried no arguments beyond the profile. Whether a well-formed anonymous checkout succeeds is not tested. One merchant endpoint is one merchant's configuration, the vendor's own store. set-cookie headers are not printed in the artifact and nothing here depends on them

finding: Twenty-five days after the first gate map and on the day the vendor rewrote one of the pages describing it, one merchant's UCP MCP endpoint answers an anonymous caller exactly as before: complete_checkout and get_order refuse with HTTP 403 AuthenticationRequired, 'A valid JWT is required to call' the tool, before any argument is read; the other eleven tools, every cart tool and the four other checkout tools among them, take the call and answer 'Missing required arguments', naming the argument each wants. The credential check runs first, per tool, and create_checkout is not gated. Nothing was created or bought: every call carried only the vendor's own example agent profile. The storefront host and the myshopify.com endpoint its discovery document names both list the same thirteen tools without a credential. No request in this pass met a transient error; the same morning's run, which has no transcript, met four 503s that a single-shot reading would have filed as refusals.

reproducibility.command: P=https://shopify.dev/ucp/agent-profiles/examples/2026-08-25/valid-with-capabilities.json; for t in cancel_cart cancel_checkout complete_checkout create_cart create_checkout get_cart get_checkout get_order get_product lookup_catalog search_catalog update_cart update_checkout; do curl -sS -m 25 -A public-agents-ci -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X POST https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"tools/call\",\"params\":{\"name\":\"$t\",\"arguments\":{\"meta\":{\"ucp-agent\":{\"profile\":\"$P\"}}}}}"; done
